backendRole: PVF storage and script access backend behind pvf-agent-core

requiredCapabilities.summary: Open a target PVF with explicit encoding and close the session without leaking write state.
List PVF paths with prefix/contains filters, stable pagination, and total-match metadata.
Find paths by filename or path fragment. This may be implemented through search or paged list fallback.
Read/decompile text and script-like PVF files with explicit read encoding.
Read up to 100 explicit PVF paths in one read-only session with bounded output.
Automatically use the TypeScript semantic result for Cn search, .str, StringLink, and non-ASCII script reads without user backend configuration.
List primary .lst registries and, when requested, parse entry counts.
Resolve numeric IDs through an explicit .lst registry and return the registered PVF path.
Resolve an exact PVF path back to the .lst registries and numeric IDs that register it.
Build or consume local path and .lst indexes with source freshness checks.

Apply a change set only with a SHA256-verified content-addressed protected-source backup, explicit output PVF, readback verification, and a full final-output SHA256 binding. A next-round delta must bind the previous successful apply manifest; its unchanged output becomes the input while the original source stays protected. Verified inline Cn or Tw text supports complete multiline tokens and exact-count batches; all verified changes on one path are applied in one string-table/script batch, while dependent ordinary deletions preserve declared order and the coordinated final file receives exact TypeScript readback.

safetyInvariants: Ordinary read-only commands must not expose write tools.
A write smoke test must write to an explicit output path and must not modify the source PVF.
The controlled change runner must create or reuse a SHA256-verified content-addressed source backup before save; the standalone bridge backup tool is not part of the controlled write surface.
A successful apply manifest must bind the full SHA256 and byte size of the final output PVF after readback.
A cumulative next round must explicitly bind and rehash the previous successful apply manifest, its output, and the original protected source; a successful output never becomes an implicit source.

Direct localization .str output, StringLink display-text writes, partial Chinese tokens, uncounted bulk writes, and other unverified non-ASCII changes must fail closed; complete visible inline Cn or Tw tokens, including multiline and exact-count batches, may proceed only after one-pass same-file batching, matching-encoding round-trip verification, and exact independent readback.
Every numeric ID used by a test must be resolved through the exact .lst registry named by the fixture.
Local indexes are acceleration artifacts only; stale indexes cannot replace target PVF readback.
